name: Maputo Railway Station
description: Discover one of Africa's most beautiful railway stations, famous for its historic architecture and impressive green dome.

name: Maputo Central Market
description: Experience the vibrant atmosphere of Maputo's central market, where visitors can discover fresh produce, seafood, local crafts, and traditional products.

name: Maputo Cathedral
description: Visit the Cathedral of Our Lady of the Immaculate Conception, an important religious and architectural landmark in the city.

name: Maputo Fortress
description: Explore the historic Fortaleza de Maputo and learn about the city's colonial history and cultural heritage.

name: FEIMA Craft Market
description: Discover Mozambican creativity through handmade crafts, traditional artwork, sculptures, paintings, and local souvenirs.

name: Tunduru Botanical Gardens
description: Enjoy a peaceful green space in the heart of Maputo, featuring beautiful trees, tropical plants, and relaxing walking paths.

name: Costa do Sol Beach
description: Experience the beautiful coastline of Maputo, with ocean views, sandy beaches, and opportunities to enjoy local seafood.

name: Independence Square
description: Explore one of Maputo's most important public squares, featuring the statue of Samora Machel and historic buildings.
